name: Create list of partner accounts in eshops
description:
- Partners currently have no way to see all their account over our pltform. This page gives the partner a self-service view of the accounts that count as their "partner accounts".

## Design

[Figma – Partner Portal (Vstup do obchodů)](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=649-42692&m=dev)

## Acceptance Criteria

- Page shows a table of e-shops the partner has access to (their own store + client stores), with columns **Název e-shopu** (store name) and **Doména** (domain).
- Each row has a "Přejít do obchodu" action that opens that store's admin in a new window/tab.
- Page header "Vstup do obchodů" with a subtitle explaining the list covers both the partner's own store and their clients' stores.

## Open question (from design)

For alpha, consulting and API partners are not distinguished in this layout. If API partners access their test store very frequently, reconsider table placement for better visibility — needs a decision before final polish.

## Technical Notes

- Data source: `project_users_synchronization` (global `st_cms` table, see `database/schema/st_cms.sql`) — mirrors each project's `admin_users` into one cross-project table keyed by `projectId` + `adminUserId`, carrying an `isPartner` flag and a `role` enum (`user`/`partner`/`manager`/`owner`). This is the natural source for "which e-shops does this partner have access to": filter rows by the partner's `adminUserId` with `isPartner=1` / `role='partner'`, then join project name + domain.
- Sync logic lives in `cms/packages/Synchronization/Users/ProjectUsersSync.php`. Existing consumers are the HubSpot/Zendesk/Twilio integrations — no Partner Portal code reads this table yet, so this would be a new consumer.
- Partner Portal scaffolding already exists as a stub: `PartnerPortalOverviewController` (`admin/controllers/PartnerPortal`) + the `PartnerPortalOverview` React page, both gated behind the `partnerPortal` module flag and owned by `@shoptet/devrel-team` per CODEOWNERS.
